description: This file is a PHP source code defining the 'Newsletter' controller class within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles the display and processing of the newsletter subscription settings within the customer account area.

classes.name: Newsletter
classes.description: The Newsletter controller class handles the display and updating of the customer's newsletter subscription preferences within their account.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the newsletter subscription page; sets up breadcrumb navigation and loads necessary view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to update the customer's newsletter subscription status, returning a JSON response indicating success or failure.
